# Issue #40 v4 R4 Final Security Review

- Worktree: `/Users/ylpromax5/Workspace/feishuspeech/.kw/worktrees/issue-40`
- Baseline: `4f9908fb1d5c8ed6eb6cc80da6e9d40c3ffdea5a`
- Scope: final R4-repaired uncommitted v4 production and tests

## Outcome

PASS. No blocker, high, medium, or low candidate-caused security defect was admitted. The repaired drain-expiry branch retains safe partial text only as a non-authoritative read-only recovery surface. It cannot materialize Send or qualified Return authority, and it cannot reach the sole delivery call before recognition action 2 and the recorder barrier complete.

## R4 authority-bypass re-falsification

1. Drain expiry now closes and invalidates the active streaming generation, cancels late work, clears transition identifiers, and then calls the recovery presenter (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:2272-2333`). The recovery helper requires no pending action-2 transition, same-generation authority, nonempty safe text, and at most 16,384 UTF-16 units; it then clears `reviewSurfaceAuthority`, leaves the state `.sealing`, and calls only `renderReadOnly(phase: .recovery)` (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:2335-2365`). It never installs an editable draft or confirmation callback.

2. The production recovery presenter clears draft/change/confirm/discard callbacks before rendering, uses the read-only recovery view, disables key interaction, ignores mouse events, and hides close (`FeishuSpeech/Controllers/ReviewWindowController.swift:95-127`). The view renders recovery as read-only sealing content and creates confirm-capable controls only for `.editable` (`FeishuSpeech/Views/TranscriptionReviewView.swift:54-127`). Therefore retained plain text and LF-delimited text are inert data, not hidden keyboard commands or authority-bearing draft state.

3. The only transition that initially creates `.editable` confirmation authority is authoritative terminal action 2 after the recorder barrier. `handleReviewTerminal` requires the live generation and capture closure, records the pending terminal, and awaits `awaitReviewRecorderBarrier`; `finishReviewTransition` rechecks live identity, same authority, pending-terminal provenance, and transition ID before setting `.editable` and installing the callbacks (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:1689-1806`). Every other `.editable` assignment merely edits, annotates, or restores an already-authoritative draft (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:238-262`, `:430-471`, `:1889-1941`, `:2044-2088`).

4. The R4 executable oracles drive a noncooperative session through recorder-barrier completion and drain expiry without action 2. For a plain partial, real fake-presenter Send and qualified Return seams both remain unmaterialized and all delivery, AX, Unicode/keyboard, copy, append, retry, retarget, and session-recreation ledgers remain zero (`FeishuSpeechTests/StreamingMainViewModelTests.swift:2006-2065`). An LF-delimited partial remains exact read-only data with zero output and suppressed late completion (`FeishuSpeechTests/StreamingMainViewModelTests.swift:2067-2111`). The migrated single-LF/empty oracle additionally proves empty data fails closed while LF data remains non-authoritative (`FeishuSpeechTests/StreamingMainViewModelTests.swift:1870-1943`).

## Full v4 claim review

1. Zero pre-confirmation side effects: streaming/nonterminal results only update the review ledger and read-only presenter, while final action 2 awaits the recorder barrier before editable authority (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:1619-1806`). Draft edits update only the in-memory authority/projection (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:1889-1916`). `MainViewModel` ignores the legacy append-session factory and contains no AX write or legacy final-output call; its only external-delivery call is inside guarded `handleReviewConfirmation` (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:337-359`, `:1950-2020`). The zero-side-effect capture-through-every-edit oracle proves no delivery, copy, final/current-focus insertion, or AX selected-text write (`FeishuSpeechTests/ReviewFirstMainViewModelTests.swift:1040-1098`).

2. No accepted-path pasteboard or Cmd+V remnant: a fresh production search found no `NSPasteboard`, general-pasteboard read/write/snapshot/restore, `changeCount`, virtual-key V, `postCommandV`, Cmd+V, or Command+V operation. Pasteboard/key-poster names in `TextInputSimulator` are methodless compatibility markers, not capabilities (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:390-397`, `:666-674`). All seven lifecycle tests passed, including image-only clipboard preservation and uncertain delivery with no retry.

3. Exact UTF-16 contract: `MainViewModel` rejects a draft over 16,384 UTF-16 units before delivery (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:1950-1973`). The poster independently rejects overflow before construction, derives both events from one complete UTF-16 array, and requires complete readback (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:775-838`). The production backend checks exact phase, same source wrapper, target PID, empty flags, exact tag, own source PID, exact stored payload, and CoreGraphics Unicode readback (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:1097-1141`). The non-BMP boundary oracle accepts 16,382 ASCII units plus one surrogate pair and rejects the 16,385-unit variant before construction (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:514-574`).

4. Prepared-pair provenance: down and up share one private event source and the full payload; both are tagged and targeted before all readbacks must succeed (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:796-838`). Readback faults for phase, payload, flags, tag, source identity/PID, and target PID fail before any post (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:576-599`).

5. Irreversible submission boundary: phase remains `notStarted` until the key-down post. Immediately afterward it becomes `submissionBoundaryCrossed`; faults or cancellation after down can only mark uncertainty, and the synchronous key-up post is unconditional (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:841-892`). Executable hook and cancellation cases prove zero events before down and exact down/up to the captured PID after the boundary (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:601-733`). No post-boundary result is reported as cancelled.

6. Stable modifiers, physical input, activation epochs, and lock order: monitoring arms both epochs, stabilizes Command/Shift/Control/Option/Fn/Caps Lock, and captures baselines (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewDestinationDelivery.swift:290-367`). Exact/application validation finishes before the short pair gate (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewDestinationDelivery.swift:632-667`; `FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:232-309`). The gate uses fixed activation-lock then input-epoch-lock ordering and rechecks both epochs, drift flags, and the full combined-session modifier set immediately before down (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewDestinationDelivery.swift:369-409`). The exact/application modifier-drift matrix proves zero posts for every relevant modifier change during final validation (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:735-828`).

7. Dual provenance in event tap and AppKit monitors: self exemption requires both the exact tag and `eventSourceUnixProcessID == getpid()` (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:597-606`). The shared event-tap epoch checks tap-disabled types first and always advances loss-of-observability before provenance exemption (`FeishuSpeech/Services/CurrentFocusAppendSession.swift:176-215`; `FeishuSpeech/Services/HotKeyService.swift:200-223`). Local and global AppKit monitors treat a missing CGEvent or any event lacking dual self provenance as external interference (`FeishuSpeech/Services/CurrentFocusAppendSession.swift:782-837`).

8. Opaque user intent: `ReviewConfirmationIntent` has a `fileprivate` initializer and is constructed only by the visible Send action or qualified native Return/Enter handler (`FeishuSpeech/Views/TranscriptionReviewView.swift:14-24`, `:235-261`, `:361-385`). Recovery has neither control. The coordinator also requires current authority ID, exact callback revision, `.editable`, a stored draft, no in-flight attempt, review-safe text, and the UTF-16 cap before the sole delivery call (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:1950-2020`).

9. No target-consumption claim and uncertain draft retention: even legacy `.inserted` maps conservatively to `.submittedUnverified`, and monitor drift maps to uncertainty (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewDestinationDelivery.swift:671-684`, `:869-889`). Every non-success/uncertain result preserves the exact frozen text, typed feedback, and returns it to editable authority without automatic retry, copy, or retarget (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:2044-2088`).

10. Asynchronous topology is preserved: capture drain and recognition consumer remain independent task roots (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:650-672`). Fn release starts a separate recorder-stop barrier and arms the bounded recognition drain only after that barrier (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:2191-2269`). The protected recorder, ingress, journal, session/provider, keep-alive, socket, and transport files are byte-identical to baseline.

## Residual delayed image-paste assessment

The prior delayed clipboard/image-paste root cause is structurally removed from the accepted path. There is no production pasteboard mutation or Cmd+V operation to queue or restore, no pre-confirmation output call from `MainViewModel`, no append-session construction, and only one delivery site after real UI confirmation. Drain expiry also revokes authority and cannot create an output callback. The candidate therefore contains no accepted-path mechanism that could later paste an image after typing or after application shutdown.
